visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Two hands hold a rectangular orange box embossed with 'LOUIS VUITTON'. Inside, five dark chocolate squares feature different brand monograms and logos. The background consists of larger orange brand shopping bags. (2) A woman with long black hair, wearing light makeup and a blue top, looks down and smiles slightly. Animated yellow sparkles and variety text appear over her face. (3) The camera captures the exterior of a luxury retail building with a modern, white, rippled facade featuring LV logos. A large red flower-shaped sculpture stands on a green lawn in the foreground. (4) Inside a well-lit showroom, various chocolate collections are displayed on white platforms. One tiered set features a large purple flower ornament. (5) A hand holds an orange shopping bag in front of a brand mascot statue. (6) A hand unties a blue ribbon from a small orange box and opens it to reveal a chocolate bar wrapped in gold-textured paper. (7) The woman breaks a section of the chocolate bar with her fingers, revealing a light-colored crispy filling. She puts it in her mouth to taste. (8) The woman holds two brand boxes in an indoor setting with warm lighting and talks directly to the camera, gesturing with the products.
